doc: Configures the D_80085FA8[0] playback/sequencer slot according to mode word D_800737C8. Clears D_800737D4 first, then dispatches on the mode via a 3-way switch (comparison tree, not a jump table): mode 1 parses a stream — func_80058850 seeds slot.f00, func_80058ABC/func_80058B2C fill D_80085FA0 and the 16-bit counts D_800869B8/D_800869B4/D_800869A8, then either a single or a counted func_80058940 scan (bounded by D_800869B4) advances an accumulator stored in D_800869B0 and slot.f1c; mode 0 initializes tempo state: slot.f00=8, computes lo=60000000/(rate>>8), writes slot.f20/f24, scales by /115, clamps to 0xFF, then halves slot.f24 by time signature (>>1 for 0x18/0x3C, >>2 for 0x1E) and calls func_800589B8; mode 2 copies three fields (off 8/0xC/4) out of the struct pointed to by D_80085FA4[0]. Finally stores D_800869A8 into D_800737C4 (with a dead but present >=0x60 conditional) and returns 1 (or 0 if the mode-1 scan returned -1).
